source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Marvel at the familiarity of Quraysh and their security, the soundness of their affairs and the orderly course of their two journeys — in winter to Yemen and in summer to the Levant — and how easy it was made, to bring what they needed.
tafsir.muyassar-2: Marvel at the familiarity of Quraysh and their security, the soundness of their affairs and the orderly course of their two journeys — in winter to Yemen and in summer to the Levant — and how easy it was made, to bring what they needed.
tafsir.muyassar-3: So let them give thanks and worship the Lord of this House in which they take pride — the Kaaba — through which they gained honor and standing; and let them affirm His oneness and worship Him sincerely.
tafsir.muyassar-4: Who fed them against severe hunger and secured them from great fear and terror.
